title: Levi bar Simon

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 141b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.141b.21): he conveyed ownership of the produce of his dovecote to Rav Yehudah. Rav Yehudah went before Mar Shmuel, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The produce of a dovecote is its young birds. The source says Levi conveyed ownership to Rav Yehudah, who then went before Shmuel; it does not mention fruit vendors.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2336&lang=en) also records Levi giving Rav Yehudah rights to the young birds and Rav Yehudah going before Shmuel.
